title: Quantitative Real-Time PCR (qRT-PCR) for 3K-SNCA Cells
author: Sara Lucas
materials: Wash with RW1 and RPE buffers; dry spin to remove ethanol.

steps.title: Lyse Cells
steps.instruction: Lyse cells directly in the 6-well plate using an appropriate volume of RLT buffer containing β-mercaptoethanol.

steps.title: Extract and Elute RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate RNA using RNeasy spin columns and elute in RNase-free water.

substeps.instruction: Bind to RNeasy spin column according to kit instructions
Elute RNA in 30–50 μL of RNase-free water

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from the extracted RNA using a reverse transcription (RT) kit.

substeps.instruction: Prepare RT master mix on ice according to kit protocol
Combine 500 ng–1 μg of RNA with RT master mix to the desired reaction volume
Incubate according to kit cycling (including genomic DNA wipeout if applicable)

steps.title: Prepare TaqMan PCR Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the quantitative PCR reactions using TaqMan master mix and cDNA templates.

substeps.instruction: Prepare TaqMan master mix for each assay consisting of Master Mix, 20× Assay, and nuclease-free water
Add equal volumes of cDNA template across wells
Seal the plate and spin briefly to remove bubbles

steps.title: Run qPCR Thermal Cycling
steps.instruction: Run the PCR for 40 cycles using the following parameters: 95 °C for 15 s, then 60 °C for 60 s (with data acquisition at the anneal/extend step).

steps.title: Analyze Amplification and Controls
steps.instruction: Verify the quality of the PCR run by confirming amplification plots and ensuring no signal is present in NTC/−RT controls.

steps.title: Calculate Relative Gene Expression
steps.instruction: Compute the fold-change in gene expression using the ΔΔCt method.

substeps.instruction: Compute ΔCt = Ct(target) − Ct(GAPDH) for each sample and target
Select a calibrator group (e.g., undifferentiated control)
Report results as mean ± SEM from biological replicates
